Variants.Content: On September 22, 1236, at Saule (Šiauliai), pagan Samogitians trapped the crusading Livonian Brothers of the Sword in treacherous quagmires. Grand Master Volkwin and nearly fifty knight-brothers were cut down when heavy destriers bogged down in autumn mud.
The total defeat crippled independent Livonian crusades, compelling survivors to merge beneath the Teutonic Order's banner.
